name: SecondsClock
tagline: Clock with seconds as widget or fullscreen
blurb: SecondsClock enables you to show a clock with seconds as a home screen widget or as a full screen night clock with dimming in low light.
description:
SecondsClock enables you to show a clock with seconds as a home screen widget or as a full screen night clock with dimming in low light.

Features:

* No Ads.
* No requests for donations or in-app purchases.
* Fully configurable.
* Adjusts text size to make use of available space.
